Spacecraft name CAS-7B (Bei ligong 1 hao, BP 1, BP-1B, BIT Progress-OSCAR 102, BO-102, CAS 7B)
Spacecraft type Nanosatellite
Units or mass 3 kg
Status Reentry 2019-08-06. Was operational according to radio amateur reports on social media.
Launched 2019-07-25
NORAD ID 44443
Deployer Unknown
Launcher Hyperbola-1
Organisation CAMSAT (Chinese Amateur Satellite Group)
Institution Non-profit
Entity Academic / Education
Country China
Oneliner

Spheriform of 500 mm diameter with a mass of 3kg and amateur radio missions.
Description

A spheriform spacecraft of 500 mm diameter with a mass of 3kg. Proposing the following functional elements:

  • UHF CW Telemetry Beacon
  • V/U FM Transponder
  • Telecommand
  • Body mounted solar Panels, Lithium ion battery and power controller
  • Integrated Housekeeping Unit
  • Spinning stabilization.
Notes

Modified 1.5U, but not really a CubeSat.
